孙强站在他面前，手里握着一把匕首，刀身鲜红，刀尖还在滴血。

“你以为我不知道你是谁？”孙强冷笑，“A级通缉犯，背着三条人命。你死在这里，条子连查都懒得查。”

赵辉咬着牙，挣扎着想爬起来。

孙强抬起脚，重重踩在赵辉的胸口。

“安心上路。”孙强举起匕首。

“砰！”

一声脆响。

一块半个拳头大的石头精准地砸在孙强的手腕上。

匕首脱手落地。

孙强捂着手腕，猛地转头看向车间入口。

“你是谁？”，同时手悄然向后腰摸去。

顾承安向他飞奔过去，没有回话，正派多死于话多。

“砰！”

还是让他对方有机会开枪了，还好反应迅捷。

顾承安在对方扣动扳机的瞬间，身体猛地向侧边扑倒。

“M的，电影误我！”一阵后怕，暗暗吐槽一句。

子弹擦着他的肩膀飞过，打在后面的铁皮门上，溅起一串火花。

顾承安就地一滚，躲到一根水泥柱后面。

“出来！”孙强一边慢慢逼近，一边大喊。

顾承安靠在水泥柱上。

他深吸一口气。

不能硬拼。

必须制造混乱。

他摸到地上的一截短钢管。

用力朝着另一个方向扔了出去。

“哐当！”

钢管砸在远处的铁架上。

孙强猛地侧身，枪口指过去。

顾承安抓住机会，从水泥柱后面窜了出来。

速度极快。

同时取出空间的水果刀，向他扔了过去。

匕首在空中划过一道弧线，直奔孙强而去。

孙强本能地侧头躲避。

顾承安已经到了他面前。

Sun Qiang stood in front of him, holding a dagger in his hand. The blade was bright red and blood was still dripping from the tip.

"You think I don't know who you are?" Sun Qiang sneered, "A-level wanted criminal, carrying three lives on his back. You died here, and the police didn't even bother to check."

Zhao Hui gritted his teeth and struggled to get up.

Sun Qiang raised his foot and stepped heavily on Zhao Hui's chest.

"Go on with peace of mind." Sun Qiang raised his dagger.

"Bang!"

There was a crisp sound.

A stone half the size of a fist hit Sun Qiang's wrist accurately.

The dagger fell to the ground.

Sun Qiang covered his wrist and turned his head suddenly to look at the entrance of the workshop.

"Who are you?" At the same time, his hand quietly touched the lower back.

Gu Chengan rushed towards him without replying. The most decent person died from talking too much.

"Bang!"

It still gave him a chance to shoot, but fortunately he reacted quickly.

The moment the opponent pulled the trigger, Gu Chengan's body suddenly fell to the side.

"Damn it, the movie misled me!" I was scared for a while and secretly complained.

The bullet grazed his shoulder and hit the iron door behind, sending up a string of sparks.

Gu Chengan rolled on the spot and hid behind a cement pillar.

"Come out!" Sun Qiang shouted as he slowly approached.

Gu Chengan leaned against the concrete pillar.

He took a deep breath.

You can't fight hard.

Chaos must be created.

He touched a short steel pipe on the ground.

He threw it forcefully in the other direction.

"Clang!"

The steel pipe hit the iron frame in the distance.

Sun Qiang turned sideways and pointed the gun at him.

Gu Chengan seized the opportunity and jumped out from behind the cement pillar.

Extremely fast.

At the same time, he took out the fruit knife from the space and threw it towards him.

The dagger drew an arc in the air and headed straight for Sun Qiang.

Sun Qiang instinctively turned his head to avoid.

Gu Chengan was already in front of him.
